LESSON: HADITH ON PURITY OF ACTIONS

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: HADITHI
Topic 2.1: Hadith on Purity of Actions

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Hadith on Purity of Actions. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is appearance and wealth not important in the eyes of Allah?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read the selected Hadith on purity of actions for moral guidance
2. apply the lessons learnt from the selected Hadith in day-to-day life
3. appreciate purity of actions to gain rewards from Allah

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: HADITH ON PURITY OF ACTIONS
This lesson teaches Hadith on Purity of Actions for Grade 6 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. read the selected Hadith on purity of actions for moral guidance
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. apply the lessons learnt from the selected Hadith in day-to-day life
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate purity of actions to gain rewards from Allah
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Hadith on Purity of Actions using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Hadith on Purity of Actions above.
2. Explain Hadith on Purity of Actions to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Hadith on Purity of Actions.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Hadith on Purity of Actions with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Hadith on Purity of Actions important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is appearance and wealth not important in the eyes of Allah?
2. What does Allah look for when rewarding His servants?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. read the selected Hadith on purity of actions for moral guidance
2. apply the lessons learnt from the selected Hadith in day-to-day life
3. appreciate purity of actions to gain rewards from Allah

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
